_comment: Selah narration script — the single source of truth for tools/voice/build_voice.py.
Wording is art-directed: do NOT edit `text`. Each line is synthesised phrase by phrase;
`phrases[].text` joined with spaces must equal the line `text` exactly (the build asserts it).
phrase fields: text, pause (seconds of silence AFTER the phrase, speech-end to speech-start),
final  ('major' = sentence-end fall, 'minor' = comma / suspended, default from punctuation),
length_scale (override), say (respelling fed to the phonemizer instead of text).
lexicon: lower-cased word -> phonemes (gruut/Mimic3 en_US symbols, stress attached to vowels).

lines.text: Before the first light, there was silence. A silence so complete, it had no edge.
And then… the silence took a breath.
In its first minutes, the universe made hydrogen. Everything else, it left to the stars.
Then gravity began to sing. And slowly, the darkness gathered itself into rivers… and the rivers caught fire.

phrases.text: the darkness gathered itself into rivers…

lines.text: This is the cosmic web. Every thread, a river of galaxies. Every galaxy, a hundred billion suns.
And around those suns… worlds. Oceans. Mountains. Cities. Someone, somewhere, looking up.
It took thirteen billion years to make eyes that could look back. Yours.

phrases.text: It took thirteen billion years to make eyes that could look back.

lines.text: In the old songs, there is a word for this moment. Selah. Pause… and behold.

phrases.text: there is a word for this moment.

lines.text: This universe is yours now. Go anywhere.
Home is a hundred thousand light-years wide.

phrases.text: Home is a hundred thousand light-years wide.

lines.text: Every sun is a long, slow sunrise.

phrases.text: Every sun is a long, slow sunrise.

lines.text: Every world is a first sentence.

phrases.text: Every world is a first sentence.

lines.text: Walk. The ground has waited a long time for you.

phrases.text: The ground has waited a long time for you.

lines.text: Go on. The horizon likes to be chased.

phrases.text: The horizon likes to be chased.

lines.text: Look up. You know the way home now.

phrases.text: You know the way home now.
